summary: Bilingual first-party discovery and current viewer inspection identified Bihar's official BhuNaksha service and Jehanabad district revenue custodian. The live selector returned Jehanabad district/circle/mauza metadata, but the selected special-survey extent request returned HTTP 204; no safe parcel ID or polygon was retained.
queryAndRequestOutcomes: All executed discovery queries and requests, including URLs, payloads, statuses, schema observations, and limits, are recorded in city-11053-jehanabad.json.

custodians.scope: State cadastral mapping and land-record services, including BhuNaksha.
custodians.evidence: Official BhuNaksha, BiharBhumi, and DLRS pages plus live selector REST responses.

safeFieldAllowlist: native parcel identifier if publicly returned and source-proven
registryBasis: A local district revenue page and a current official state cadastral viewer with Jehanabad administrative selectors were evidenced. This does not establish open citywide parcel geometry completeness.
coverageLimits: Only selector metadata was verified for Jehanabad; no parcel geometry was returned.
The exact WUP point was not shifted and no exact-point absence inference was made.
No citywide or countrywide coverage qualification was performed.
uncertainty: The selected map extent route returned HTTP 204.
Direct WMS capabilities and direct village-selector fetch did not yield usable schema responses.
A later attempt may need to reproduce the interactive viewer sequence or a different populated map instance.
doNotInfer: No geometry is not evidence that Jehanabad has no parcels.
The packet is research evidence only, not source integration or admission.
